GoConnecte — Car Rental Support

Welcome to GoConnecte Car Rental Support. We assist both Renters (Users) and Hosts (Car Owners) with anything related to bookings, vehicle listings, payments, or platform usage. Whether you are renting a car or listing your vehicle to earn — we ensure a smooth and secure experience.

Platform Roles

  • User (Renter): Search, book, and rent cars from available listings.
  • Host (Car Owner): List vehicles and earn by renting them out.
  • You can switch between User and Host roles anytime from your dashboard.

How We Can Help

  • Account setup, login & role switching assistance
  • Car listing setup and management support for Hosts
  • Booking and cancellation guidance for Renters
  • Payment processing and refund support
  • Damage claims or dispute resolution assistance
  • Reporting suspicious activity or safety concerns
  • Technical troubleshooting (Website or App)

When to Contact Support

If you experience booking issues, unexpected cancellations, payment delays, listing problems, or any safety-related concerns — please contact us immediately. We are committed to maintaining a secure and transparent car rental platform.
